<section id="cross-ledger-references">
<h1>Cross-ledger references</h1>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ledgercore.refs</span></code> provides a canonical scheme for referencing records across
independent ledgers.</p>
<section id="local-ids">
<h2>Local IDs</h2>
<p>Inside a single ledger, records use local IDs:</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>task-0001
adr-0002
spec-0003
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>A local ID has the form <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">&lt;kind&gt;-&lt;number&gt;</span></code>, where kind is a lowercase alphanumeric
token and number is a zero-padded positive integer.</p>
</section>
<section id="global-refs">
<h2>Global refs</h2>
<p>When linking records across ledgers, use canonical global refs:</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>&lt;ledger&gt;:&lt;kind&gt;-&lt;number&gt;
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Examples:</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>tl:task-0001
al:adr-0002
sw:spec-0003
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The ledger code is a short lowercase token that identifies the originating
ledger. It is not a URL or a path; downstream packages choose their own codes.</p>
</section>
<section id="file-safe-refs">
<h2>File-safe refs</h2>
<p>For filenames or systems that cannot use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">:</span></code>, replace the colon with a hyphen:</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>tl-task-0001
al-adr-0002
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="legacy-underscore-alias">
<h2>Legacy underscore alias</h2>
<p>The parser also accepts underscore-based aliases:</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>tl_task_0001
al_adr_0002
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>These exist for backward compatibility. New code should use canonical or
file-safe forms.</p>
</section>
<section id="parsing">
<h2>Parsing</h2>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">ledgercore.refs</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">parse_resource_ref</span>

<span class="n">ref</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">parse_resource_ref</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;tl:task-0001&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">ref</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ledger</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">&quot;tl&quot;</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">ref</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">kind</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">&quot;task&quot;</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">ref</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">number</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">1</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">ref</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">local_id</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">&quot;task-0001&quot;</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">ref</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">global_ref</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">&quot;tl:task-0001&quot;</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">ref</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">file_ref</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">&quot;tl-task-0001&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">parse_resource_ref</span></code> accepts canonical, file-safe, legacy, and local forms.
When parsing a local ref, set <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">default_ledger</span></code> to attach a namespace:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">ref</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">parse_resource_ref</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;task-0001&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">default_ledger</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;tl&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">ref</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">global_ref</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">&quot;tl:task-0001&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="allowed-ledgers-and-kinds">
<h2>Allowed ledgers and kinds</h2>
<p>Restrict parsing to known values:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">ledgercore.refs</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">parse_resource_ref</span>

<span class="n">ref</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">parse_resource_ref</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s2">&quot;tl:task-0001&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">allowed_ledgers</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;tl&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;al&quot;</span><span class="p">},</span>
    <span class="n">allowed_kinds</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;task&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;adr&quot;</span><span class="p">},</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="cross-ledger-link-example">
<h2>Cross-ledger link example</h2>
<div class="highlight-yaml notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nt">source</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">tl:task-0001</span>
<span class="nt">target</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">al:adr-0002</span>
<span class="nt">relation</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">implements</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Both endpoints are unambiguous because each carries its ledger namespace.</p>
</section>
<section id="formatting">
<h2>Formatting</h2>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">ledgercore.refs</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">LedgerResourceRef</span>

<span class="n">ref</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">LedgerResourceRef</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">ledger</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;tl&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">kind</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;task&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">number</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">ref</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">format</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;canonical&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># &quot;tl:task-0001&quot;</span>
<span class="n">ref</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">format</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;file&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>       <span class="c1"># &quot;tl-task-0001&quot;</span>
<span class="n">ref</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">format</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;local&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>      <span class="c1"># &quot;task-0001&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="checking-validity">
<h2>Checking validity</h2>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">ledgercore.refs</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">is_resource_ref</span>

<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">is_resource_ref</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;tl:task-0001&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">is_resource_ref</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;not-a-ref&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
